candidates.title: [RFC]: Encoder-Only Prefill in P/D deployment for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  ## Summary  DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash can construct the target model's reusable global KV state without executing the complete decoder stack. In a P/D deployment where Decode already rebuilds sliding-window attention (SWA) state through bounded replay, this creates an opportunity to eliminate decoder computation on Prefill and initialize DSpark entirely on Decode.
